title: Multi-line component labels
description: Support intentional line breaks in graph and metadata component labels with content-aware node sizing.
completion_criteria: Graph labels accept an escaped newline without changing the line-oriented graph grammar.
Metadata labels preserve real YAML newlines.
Node width follows the longest line and height follows line count.
Rectangle, database, circle, diamond, and icon-bearing nodes render centered multi-line labels.
Syntax and AI authoring guidance document the contract.
Targeted tests, typecheck, and production build pass.
success_criteria: Authors can control component label wrapping without manual node dimensions.
Multi-line labels remain inside component geometry.
triage_notes: Automatic wrapping remains out of scope; authors explicitly choose display line breaks while stable node IDs remain unchanged.
